name: com.faolline.graphgameflow
description: Orchestrator / host layer above com.faolline.graphcore: the Unity host bridge that runs the headless graph runtime inside a live scene. Provides a MonoBehaviour driver (GraphFlowDriver) and the standard scene actions (LoadSceneAction / UnloadSceneAction). This is the one ecosystem layer where Unity-specific concerns (MonoBehaviour, SceneManager, the frame tick) are intentionally allowed.
